SQX144-EV-000003.title: Backtest price-event precision modes
SQX144-EV-000003.question: How does SQX construct price events for selected-timeframe, minute, and real-tick precision?

conditions: Selected Timeframe, 1 Minute, Real Tick with custom spread, and Real Tick with real spread modes

claim.statement: SQX documents four synthetic price events per selected-timeframe bar, four events per minute in minute precision, recorded bid with a derived ask under custom spread, and recorded bid/ask under real-spread tick precision.
limitations: Exact intrabar traversal, timestamp tie-breaking, gap handling, and same-bar stop/target resolution are not established.

location.notes: Selected timeframe, minute, and real-tick mode descriptions.

validation.procedure: Use bars and tick fixtures with distinct OHLC/bid/ask values to measure event count, value construction, traversal order, timestamp ties, gaps, and same-event protective-order outcomes.
validation.expected_observation: Documented mode-level event counts and bid/ask construction match; unresolved ordering is either measured or remains explicitly unverified.

SQX144-EV-000004.title: Ordered robustness funnel and early dismissal
SQX144-EV-000004.question: How does SQX order expensive robustness checks and handle failure?

claim.statement: SQX runs configured cross-checks as an ordered cost funnel and can dismiss a strategy after a failed mandatory check instead of running later expensive checks.
limitations: The exact cancellation boundary and every plugin-specific failure rule remain unverified.

location.notes: Ordered funnel, cost progression, and dismissal behavior.
Bundled example confirms ordered configurable check definitions and acceptance conditions.

validation.procedure: Configure one cheap passing check, one failing mandatory check, and one expensive later check; record invocation order and skip reason.
validation.expected_observation: The failing mandatory check prevents the later check and the verdict retains both the failure and explicit skip reason.

clean_room.notes: Bundled task values are treated as examples, not defaults.

SQX144-EV-000005.title: Walk-forward matrix grid and cluster evaluation
SQX144-EV-000005.question: What does SQX's walk-forward matrix evaluate?

claim.statement: SQX evaluates walk-forward results across a matrix of run/window configurations and out-of-sample percentages, applies customizable pass criteria, and can evaluate neighborhoods of passing cells.
limitations: A 3 by 3 neighborhood with 7 of 9 passing is an official example, not a universal product default.
Exact cell-boundary and incomplete-window behavior remains unverified.

location.notes: Matrix dimensions, criteria, result, and cluster examples.

validation.procedure: Construct a small matrix with pass/fail cells around threshold boundaries and verify deterministic cell generation and configurable neighborhood evaluation.
validation.expected_observation: Matrix and cluster verdicts follow the selected criteria without treating documentation examples as implicit defaults.

clean_room.notes: Thresholds are recorded only as examples.

SQX144-EV-000006.title: Documented similar-strategy dismissal profile
SQX144-EV-000006.question: How does SQX's documented similar-strategy databank filter identify duplicates?

claim.statement: The documented SQX similarity profile compares trade count, net profit, and drawdown over the full sample; strategies are similar when all three values are within plus or minus 5 percent, and the higher-fitness strategy is retained.
limitations: The rule is a named reference profile, not a required HaruQuantAI default.
Zero baselines, exact comparison inclusivity, and fitness ties require boundary fixtures.

location.notes: Compared metrics, tolerance, sample scope, and retained strategy.

validation.procedure: Evaluate pairs immediately below, at, and above the 5 percent boundary, including zero metrics and equal fitness.
validation.expected_observation: All three metrics must satisfy the configured tolerance and the deterministic retention/tie policy is explicit.

clean_room.notes: Public behavior is represented as a configurable compatibility profile.

SQX144-EV-000007.title: Portfolio Composer weight semantics
SQX144-EV-000007.question: How do weight changes affect an SQX Portfolio Composer result?

claim.statement: SQX Portfolio Composer applies member weights by recalculating position sizing and recomputing the portfolio result; this manual composition workflow is distinct from Portfolio Master search.
limitations: Exact shared-margin, currency conversion, netting, and simultaneous-event rules remain unverified.

location.notes: Weight changes, position sizing, and product distinction.

validation.procedure: Replay two immutable member results against shared capital, change one member weight, and compare position sizes, account path, lineage, and unchanged member artifacts.
validation.expected_observation: A new portfolio result reflects recalculated sizing while source member backtests remain immutable.
